Your hair salon in South Pattaya

A simple trim, a different shape or a new colour: start with the look you want to wear. Kannika offers men's and women's haircuts, colouring, styling and hair care on South Pattaya Soi 16.

View prices & plan your visit ↗Call the salon ↗

Cuts and everyday styling

Choose a men's haircut, a women's cut or a layered shape, then discuss your preferred finish with the salon. Wash and blow-dry, flat-iron styling, volume blow-dries and curls are listed in our service menu. Bring a reference photo if you have a particular look in mind.

  • Men's and women's haircuts
  • Wash and blow-dry
  • Flat-iron styling and curls
  • Occasion styling and updos

Colour, texture and hair care

The colour menu includes root touch-ups, grey coverage, single-process colour, bleaching, highlights and balayage. Straightening, perms and hair treatments are also available. Tell the salon about previous colour or chemical treatments so you can discuss the service and finish before your appointment.

  • Root colour and grey coverage
  • Highlights and balayage
  • Straightening and perms
  • Hair treatments and scalp spa

Before your appointment

What affects the price of a hair service?

The selected treatment, hair length and the work needed can affect the final price. Check the menu for the listed range and confirm the total with the salon before starting.

Can I combine a haircut with another service?

Tell the salon which services you want when you request an appointment. Your requested combination and time are confirmed by the salon.
